actions.board: Tray → Shot; eligible characters on the board (same room) get the target ring; tap one; confirm in the strip.
actions.self: Not offered: ordinary shots target another player.
actions.hospitalJail: Only where the view offers it.
actions.public: None. A later health or location change is drawn by cue-status-change and cue-public-move, without a cause.

actions.self: Not offered: Disabler attacks target another player.
actions.hospitalJail: Only where the view offers it.

actions.board: As Shot; the player's own character is eligible when the view lists it.
actions.self: Offered when the view lists the player's own seat (Protection's self-target exception).
actions.hospitalJail: Only where the view offers it.
actions.public: None. Protection stays the Undercover's private fact, including to its recipient.

actions.board: As Shot; a character in the Hospital bed is a target when the view lists it (the Cracker's explicit Hospital exception).
actions.self: Offered when the view lists it (injured self-Rescue).
actions.public: None. A later health change is drawn without a giver.

actions.board: As Shot. After the turn, the Hack phase has its own full minute. The requester remains the public active seat; only the partner association is in Card.
actions.hospitalJail: Only where the view offers it.

actions.board: In the Final Zone panel: eligible characters get the target ring; tap one; confirm.
actions.hospitalJail: Not applicable: everyone still in the match is in the Final Zone.

actions.board: Tap a character; then guess Blue, Red or Alien inline in the strip; confirm.
actions.self: Offered when the view lists it.
actions.hospitalJail: Only where the view offers it.
actions.public: None. The result is listed in the Card, privately, as the server gives it.

actions.board: Tap two distinct characters; each pick checked alike (a set: no numbers), named in seat order; Take back removes the last; confirm.
actions.self: Only if the view lists it.
actions.hospitalJail: Only where the view offers it.
actions.public: None. Supplier and recipient acknowledgments appear only in their own Card.

actions.offers: self.codeAttemptAvailable; every seat of the match
actions.board: Tap four distinct characters in any rooms; each pick checked alike on the board and clipped into the Code card in seat order (a set, never positions: design/abilities/); Take back removes the last; confirm.
actions.self: The player's own seat may be one of the four.
actions.hospitalJail: Any room, as every seat may be named.
actions.public: None. The attempt is not even repeated in the receipt.

actions.board: Tap an eligible character anywhere on the board; Abstain is inline; confirm.
actions.self: Only if the view lists it.
actions.public: Only the published count when the vote closes (lastTally). Individual ballots stay private.

actions.board: Tap an eligible jailed character in the Jail; No release request is inline; confirm.
actions.public: The next phase (a release vote and its subject) is public.

actions.board: No character is picked: the subject is marked On the ballot on the board (public); Yes, No and Abstain are inline; confirm.
actions.hospitalJail: The subject is in the Jail.
actions.public: The subject and, when it closes, the count.

actions.board: Not in the tray. Press a room's name tag; a dashed You? marks the place tentatively; confirm; the piece moves with the public update. A full room (five, the owner's capacity) says FULL on its tag and is never offered; pressing it says the release's words.
actions.hospitalJail: Hospital and Jail are not destinations: their tags are captions, not buttons.
actions.public: The move itself, on every screen, from the public update; and FULL on a room that holds five, from public occupancy.

actions.offers: legalTargets.PASS_TURN = [own seat], on the player's own ordinary turn; absent in legacy matches
actions.board: The center of the bottom bar; no target; confirm in the strip; a neutral receipt; the next phase in the status bar.
actions.hospitalJail: Not applicable; injured and jailed players keep their turn.
actions.public: The next phase and active turn.

vocabulary.about: The states every one of the nine characters has. They are drawn by the same rules for all nine: a character's picture never selects a rule, and nothing about a role or a faction changes any of them. What differs per character is public: its picture. Where it is drawn and in what gesture follows public facts only: its room, the place it holds there, Injured and Eliminated.

states.drawn: The figure at its place in its room, in the place's own gesture (five places a room, each with a gesture of its own; the Command Room's one is the Captain's, at the chart table); in a crowd of six or more, or in the Final Zone, one of three standing stances by seat number. Injured: the same gesture with a bandage; Eliminated: the place's fall. Number and name on a plate under its press area.
A focus outline on the 44 px press area; a light press tint while pressed.
Dashed caption-yellow ring at the base and a + tab; the others faint.
Solid ring and the pick's number.
Dotted ring, ellipsis stamp; the strip's Sending stamp.
The private marks are gone; the strip carries the Registered stamp. Nothing is drawn on the character.
Faint, without a ring (not offered); a rejection is said in the strip with a hatched stamp, never on the character.

Gets up from its place, walks above the board to its new room with an ink trail (limping and bandaged when Injured), and settles into its new place's gesture with a landing puff. The same walk for every character.

A marker stamped on: Injured (and a bandage at its place), Eliminated (the place's fall, grey, the revealed faction), Captain, Jailed. A health change is first marked by one hit, the same for every cause (cue-public-hit).
The turn marker above the head.

facts.about: Every fact the board draws, the authorized source it is read from at the pinned tuple, who may see it and the cues that draw it. Nothing is drawn from anything else. A place (where in a room a character is drawn, and so its gesture) is not a game fact: every device works it out the same way from public occupancy, seat order and the places drawn before (design/board-motion/js/layout.js).

gaps.about: What this design needs that the pinned tuple does not provide, and what it deliberately does not draw. None is a contract change made here: Integration owns the contracts.

list.what: Jailed, Captain and revealed-faction changes have no event of their own.
list.decision: Draw them from the difference between two drawn views, as the release's director does for health and location. No contract change is proposed.

list.what: The owner's reference asked for at most five players in a room; on 9 October 2026 the owner said “lets say the maximum capacity of each room is 5”, and on 11 October 2026 “yes enforce 5 as a hard rule”, deciding its six cases the same day (“yes go with your recommendations for all six”). The rules and the engine have no room capacity yet: rules/overlays/location-board-layout-v1.json says "Unnumbered token areas avoid imposing an artificial room-capacity rule", and the server's starting rooms are an independent coin flip for each player (issue #83).
list.decision: Five fixed places a room, each with its own gesture (the Command Room one, the Captain's), a character keeping its place while it stays; the Eliminated count. A full room says FULL on its tag, on every screen, from public occupancy: Room A and Room B, never offered when full, and the Hospital and the Jail, where a full Hospital is why an Injured character waits in its room. No fixture offers a full room. The engine is to enforce the rule and its six cases (DSN-D27, DSN-REQ-12, issue #96, Backend, with Balance's audit); until it does, a view with six to nine in one room is still drawn, as a 3 x 3 crowd in which everyone can be pressed (layout stress).

list.what: The reference draws arrows and lights along a corridor between rooms. The rules give no adjacency: rules/overlays/location-board-layout-v1.json says its dotted paths "illustrate possible Captain access, not a finalized adjacency decision".
list.decision: A steel spine with four lamps between the columns, no arrow, door or path.

list.what: Room subtitles (Captain, Engineering, Laboratory) come from the reference, not from the rules or the release.
list.decision: Proposed words, aria-hidden; the room's name is what is read and pressed.

list.what: The five room scenes (each approved room around a new deck, the props of its places and its light, and the layers drawn in front of a place: the chart table, the laboratory bench, the two beds) are not in the reviewed manifest design-0.2.0.
list.decision: Built from the approved sources, their groups lifted unchanged and printed by the reviewed export recipes, as a versioned proposal (board-motion-0.3.0, one public stylesheet loaded before the first match view); adopted only through an Integration review of a later manifest revision (DSN-D30).

list.what: The Final Zone has no picture of its own in the reviewed kit.
list.decision: The page's paper ground with the approved halftone and speed lines. A picture is a later asset decision.

list.what: The full-body figures (the nine characters in 27 gestures: 21 places, three crowd stances, three falls; and a move and a hit from every gesture; owner's decisions of 9 October 2026) are not in the reviewed manifest design-0.2.0, and the runtime still draws the approved bust standees.
list.decision: Drawn live by one rig in design/board-motion/figures/ after the approved standees, in their own colors, as a versioned proposal (board-motion-0.3.0): no figure art is fetched; the sheets of every gesture are written on request for review. Adopting them is an Integration step and drawing them the game Frontend's (DSN-D32).

list.what: design/contract/crew-catalog.json says a character never changes with health, Jail, the Captain or anything private, and that those are markers on the piece. A figure's gesture follows public facts: the place it holds in its room, the Captain at the chart table, a bandage when Injured, the place's fall when Eliminated.
list.decision: The character (face, skin, hair, colors, suit) never changes; only the gesture does, from public facts only, and every marker is still drawn. Whether a gesture may say what a marker says is for the game owner, with Integration for the catalog (DSN-D33).

list.what: The owner asked for an animation “if got shot” for every gesture. A public view says only that a health changed, never that a shot was fired, by whom, with what or from where (a Disable and a showdown shot also deal damage). The reviewed motion contract accepts “a health change is a status change with no impact”, and motion-direction.md allows a burst only when the attack type is public.
list.decision: One hit for every cause (cue-public-hit, a proposal): a burst and a jolt where the character is, then a flinch back into its gesture with a bandage (Injured) or the place's fall (Eliminated). No lettering, weapon, shooter, trajectory or direction. Drawing a shot as a shot needs a public shot fact: a rules and contract decision (DSN-D35).

components.about: What the prototype draws, and the hook of the pinned release (packages/presentation/src/markup/comic-shell.ts, parts.ts and apps/game/hosted/ at 94a49ce) it maps onto. reuse: the hook exists and keeps its meaning; extend: the hook exists and the design adds to it; proposed: nothing in the release draws it yet.

list.about: One comic page: Command Room across the top, Room A and Room B, Hospital and Jail, a spine between the columns. Band heights follow public occupancy (--band-top, --band-middle, --band-lower).

A room as a panel and a scene (owner's decision of 9 October 2026): the approved room around a new deck, the props of its five places and its light, framed on its places at every panel size; what is drawn in front of a place (the chart table, the laboratory bench, a bed) is a layer of its own, stacked between the characters by depth.
The room's name as its move control. The button is the press area, at least 44 x 44; the slanted caption is drawn inside it. The same neutral button on every phone.
A caption, not a control: Hospital and Jail are never movement destinations.

A character at a place in its room, as a full-body comic figure drawn live by the figure rig in the place's gesture (owner's decisions of 9 October 2026): five places a room, each with its own gesture (at the workstation, crouched at the hatch, at the microscope, in a bed, on the bench, at the door), the Command Room's the Captain's at the chart table. The places come from who is in the room by seat number, the same on every screen. Injured: the same gesture with a bandage; Eliminated: the place's fall. In a crowd of six or more or in the Final Zone, one of three standing stances by seat number. Over a prop, a second layer (the hands on the desk, the arms on the blanket) is drawn in front of it. Seat number and name on a plate under the press area.

The press area on an eligible character: on its upper body (on the head, lying in a bed or on a cot), at least 44 x 44, never overlapping another or a room tag, never reaching under a tag. The board gives each band the height that keeps every taken place's press area whole and apart.

The viewer's own open action drawn on the characters: eligible (a dashed ring around the press area, + tab), selected (outlined, check), picked (outlined, checked alike: a set), pending (dotted), other (faint). Own board only.
The number of a pick in a Supply or a Code attempt: a visual aid, not an order.

The tentative place of the viewer's own move: the viewer's own figure, faint and dashed, at the place it would take there by the same rule as everyone's, labeled You?, in the room pressed. The real piece moves only with the public update.
Captain, Injured, Eliminated with the revealed faction, Jailed, the active turn: pictures of the approved markers, and the same words in the readable list.
On the ballot over the subject of a release vote; the published count over each counted character when a vote closes.

Above navigation: the action's name set into the question, one control at the side, answers and the confirmation in one row. Selection, progress, confirmation and the receipt all stay here, on the board's screen.
A stamp on the strip's edge: Sending, Registered, Not accepted (hatched, no red), Unknown (dotted). The same Registered stamp for every action.
A compact two-column tray over the lower board with only the actions the viewer's view opens; Move is not in it.
Board, Actions, Pass in the middle, Card, Menu. Pass is drawn the same on every phone; it is available only on the viewer's own ordinary turn and absent in legacy matches.
Round, phase or whose turn, and the timer. Its size never changes.

A layer over the board that takes no pointer events: a moving character walks in it from its old room to its new one, with an ink trail and a landing puff; a hit's burst is drawn in it at the character's chest.
The private Card over the lower board: the role with its held device, knowledge, own ballot. Built only while open.
